description: Toward a Framework for the Sustainable Heating Transition in Europe and Central Asia (ECA) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy demand, Energy efficiency", published or maintained by Luiz Gabriel Sucrmont Rodrigues Simoes (World Bank Group). The report, conducted in 2022-23, examines how to provide efficient, clean, and affordable heating services for everyone. Coverage: 22 countries in Europe and Central Asia. It has 2 files in XLSX, PDF. The portal files it under Energy demand, Energy efficiency, Policies and plans. The portal gives 2023 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
